evals.prompt: set up a golden image pipeline for our app servers
evals.expected_output: Builds the image reproducibly from a versioned Packer template or Dockerfile in a pipeline (not a hand-built snapshot), tags each build with the source commit, scans it before promotion, and deploys by replacing instances via the orchestrator with health checks before old instances terminate.

evals.prompt: instances in the fleet keep behaving differently from each other for no clear reason
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses config drift from ad hoc SSH changes on running instances and treats any manually-discovered change as an incident, since the fix is removing standing SSH access for routine changes and baking every provisioning step into the image build instead.

evals.prompt: i'll just ssh in and patch this one instance real quick instead of rebuilding the image
evals.expected_output: Pushes back: changes must be baked into the image and rolled out as a new instance, never applied to a running one, because the two-second SSH fix is exactly how drift gets reintroduced and breaks the ability to trace a running instance back to its source.
